title: Congolese scholarship students demonstrate in Benin
reason: Physical action occurred outside the assigned Republic of Congo territory.
notes: January 19 report dates action to preceding weekend, without exact day or count. Benin unit separately excludes because target is foreign Congo government; no automatic reassignment or merge.

title: Premature pro-candidate campaign rallies criticized by CSLC
reason: Reported rallies support a presidential candidate; no demand against state policy established.
notes: January 24 CSLC declaration/publication date does not identify start date of each referenced rally. Party identity alone is not exclusion; observed pro-support purpose is.

title: UPADS national council decides election nonparticipation
reason: Internal party governance council, without a distinct public protest assembly.
notes: Reported January 27–30 session dates are meeting dates; council boycott decision is not a completed street protest.

title: Deputies hold youth dialogue meetings in Nkayi
reason: Official civic dialogue; distinct public protest gathering not demonstrated.
notes: Two hotel meetings, grievances heard but not specified; no crowd threshold. Do not infer accommodation of E001 without evidence connecting the demands and participants.

title: Mpila blast victims enter ministerial office
reason: Outside January and explicitly about ten people, below 50.
notes: Weekly January 6 issue reports earlier December 29 action. Disaster casualties are not current protest casualties.

title: Moukondo water shortage report
reason: Service grievance article without an actual protest gathering.
notes: January 5 publication is not a gathering date. ADIAC credited; republication not independent corroboration.
